ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85-90% high-intensity white surface area relative to 10-15% low-intensity black/dark-grey pigmentation located at the base, trailing edges, and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central high-intensity white region. Low-intensity dark pigmentation at the peduncle insertion point forming two distinct vertical projections. A solitary dark elliptical focal spot is located in the upper-mid region of the right lobe. Irregular dark mottling is present on the distal left and right lobe extremities.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15 pixels relative to the surrounding edge peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations spanning the entire trailing edge boundary. Pixel-amplitude of vertical deviations varies between 2 and 8 pixels across the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric curve follows a slightly convex trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of irregular circular pixel groups located on the far distal margins of both lobes, indicating localized surface texture variation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct small, dark oval focal spot on the right lobe and significant irregular scarring/mottling on the outer distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'tuning fork' pigmentation pattern at the basal insertion point of the fluke where it meets the peduncle.
